interpretation.text: SUBSTRATE NOT READY -- not a verdict on ARC-007. Non-vacuity gate RED in EVERY arm: arm 'A0_INTACT' failed executed_action_diversity; arm 'A1_HIPPO_ABLATED' failed (no applied preconditions); arm 'A2_RESIDUE_PERMUTED' failed executed_action_diversity; arm 'A3_RESIDUE_FROZEN' failed (no applied preconditions). No arm is scored; this run is NOT a refutation.

preconditions.name: A0_INTACT::residue_structure_live
preconditions.description: cross-center variance of active residue RBF weights -- a flat field makes the permutation a no-op and would manufacture a false FAIL
preconditions.control: active centers accumulated over the full training phase

preconditions.name: A0_INTACT::base_effect_reproduced
preconditions.description: absolute A0->A1 eval harm-rate gap; reproduces the EXQ-114 base effect so a degradation has something to be attributed against
preconditions.control: A1 uniform-random selection vs A0 intact hippocampal selection

preconditions.name: A0_INTACT::candidate_score_range
preconditions.description: cross-candidate RANGE of residue trajectory scores on a positive control -- the SAME statistic the argmin selection routes on. A uniform offset has large magnitude but ~0 range and must trip readiness, never read as a refuted claim (V3-EXQ-643 rule)
preconditions.control: CEM candidates that genuinely differ, probed in P0 after training

preconditions.name: A0_INTACT::executed_action_diversity
preconditions.description: distinct EXECUTED action classes. This is the statistic the DV literally routes on: harm_rate is a function of the executed action stream, so if every tick executes the same class the DV is INVARIANT under the residue manipulation and no result is a measurement. Measured directly on this substrate: selecting via action_object_decoder argmax collapses to 1 class at every tick, while the E3 path spans 2 -- hence the E3 path (see _select_action)
preconditions.control: E3-selected actions over the post-training positive-control probe
